blurb: A flowing first lap: one jump, one banked turn, full throttle.
Through the pines on packed snow. Brake early, the snow car is heavy.
Wide sand, long sweepers and a big jump over the ravine.
Your first wall turn at sunset. Commit and keep it pinned.
Gravel road through the woods. Slide it, do not fight it.
Under the floodlights: a loop, a wall and a loop again.
Stadium car on tarmac, rally car through the dirt, and back.
Glide across the frozen lake. On ice, less steering is more.
Three ravines in a row and a climb between them.
Drop into the half-pipe, then tip over onto the tilted straight.
Stadium car to the snow gate, snow car over the pass, stadium car home.
Climb to the top of the hill, then corkscrew back down.
Desert car on the dunes, rally car through the canyon dirt.
Reactor boost, cruise control and a wall turn under the lights.
Stadium, rally, snow, desert: one track, four cars.
Narrow road high above the field. No-steer pads before the jumps.
Down the mountain on ice, rally car through the slush, snow car to finish.
Big air on sand, then the stadium car and two wall turns.
Loop, tilt, loop, wall. And a slow-motion pad where you least want it.
Two laps: tarmac, a rally sector through the trees, tarmac again.
Every pad in the book between two wall turns and a loop.
Narrow ice lanes, a frozen spiral and the engine cut on the climb.
Huge jumps on sand, then the stadium car over the last ravine.
Wall, loop, spiral, wall: the stadium car at full stretch.
The whole game in one run: four cars, walls, loops and the big ravine.
Throttle, brake, steer. Brake before the corner, not in it.
Hit the ramps flat out and land on the slope.
Keep your speed up and the wall holds you.
Full speed into the loop; let the car follow it round.
The rally car slides on dirt: turn in early and power out.
Snow grips, ice does not. Smooth hands.
Light and bouncy: the desert car flies off every crest.
Drive through a gate and you change car on the spot.
